findings.title: Light-theme color of .custom-message-length silently changed from 70% to 30% lightness
findings.body: The diff replaces `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%)` with `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%))`. The light-theme branch now uses 30% instead of 70%, so the text becomes much darker in light themes. The PR is meant to add a dark-theme variant, not change the light-theme color, so this is an unintended visual regression.

findings.title: Light-theme .topic-map h3 color changed from 20% to 50% lightness
findings.body: In `.topic-map h3`, the original `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 20%)` became `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%))`. The light-theme value shifts from 20% to 50%, so the heading is noticeably lighter on light backgrounds. The dark-theme branch was also altered, which the PR does not describe.

findings.title: Light-theme .group-member-info .name color changed from 30% to 50% lightness
findings.body: The original `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)` was replaced with a `dark-light-choose` whose light branch is `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%)`. This changes the light-theme name color on the user page group member list, which is not part of a dark-theme fix.

findings.title: Light-theme .group-member-info .name color changed from 30% to 50% lightness
findings.body: The `.group-member-info .name` rule originally used `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)`. The replacement uses a light branch of 50%, so desktop group member names render lighter in light themes. This is a light-theme regression unrelated to the dark-theme intent.

findings.title: Light-theme .topic-meta-data h5 link color changed from 30% to 70% lightness
findings.body: In `.embedded-posts .topic-meta-data h5 a`, the light branch was changed from `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)` to `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%)`. That makes the link text far lighter on light backgrounds, which is an accidental change to the light theme.

findings.title: Comment still describes the old single-value color for topic list cells
findings.body: The comment above `.coldmap-*` says the default table cell color is `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%)`. That is no longer accurate, since the table cell default is now `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, 50%), scale-color($secondary, 50%))`. The comment should be updated to match.
